# Sobha One World Hoskote

> 300-acre pre-launch luxury apartment township by Sobha Limited in Hoskote, East Bangalore.
> 1-4 BHK apartments from Rs 1.09 Cr* onwards. Location: Sarakariguttahalli, Hoskote, Karnataka 562114, India.
> Coordinates 13.0712 N, 77.7988 E. Sales: 080-4588 8783.

This site is operated by an authorised channel partner and is not the official Sobha Limited
website. RERA registration for Phase 1 is under process with the Karnataka Real Estate
Regulatory Authority; no RERA number has been issued yet.

Key facts: ~300 acres | 14-18 towers of G+45 to G+53 | 70% open green space | 50+ amenities |
1 BHK ~734 sq.ft from Rs 1.09 Cr* | 2 BHK ~1,150 sq.ft | 3 BHK Luxe ~1,600 sq.ft |
4 BHK Grande ~2,650 sq.ft | 5 min to NH-75 | 20 min to Whitefield | 25 min to ITPL |
40 min to Kempegowda International Airport.
